A <br> just before </a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br></a>Beta", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
